What We Do!

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.27.4″ text_font=”Work Sans|600|||||||” text_text_color=”#FFFFFF” text_font_size=”16px” text_line_height=”1.4em” custom_margin=”50px||50px||true” hover_enabled=”0″ locked=”off” global_colors_info=”{}” theme_builder_area=”post_content” sticky_enabled=”0″]

Managing who comes and goes from your property is a key part of keeping it secure. At McQuage Security and Electronics, we offer customized access control systems that give you full control over entry points—whether it’s a single door or an entire facility. From keypad entry and keycard systems to app-based solutions and biometric access, we tailor each setup to fit your specific needs.

Our access control systems are designed to enhance security while also simplifying everyday operations. You’ll know exactly who’s coming in, when, and where—while keeping unauthorized visitors out. Plus, you can manage permissions remotely and receive instant notifications, adding another layer of convenience and protection.

With McQuage, you get more than just a lock on the door—you get a smarter, more secure way to protect your property.
